decisions.reason: The candidate already requires literal extraction from the attached Option 2 Hero V terminal; message 122 reiterates rather than changes that state.
The Hero V state already identifies the attached Option 2 as the unchanged foundation instead of the different form in the family presentation.
Message 122 concerns alignment of the capital V, lowercase v, and É accent and does not change the deferred E and L letterform requirements.
The instruction to verify the V family before progressing does not alter or resume the deferred wordmark kerning requirement.
Selecting the exact Option 2 geometry and its derivation relationships does not change the deferred champagne-gold material treatment.
The attached Option 2 is used as design reference evidence, but message 122 does not change the accepted review-image formats or report a format-accessibility outcome.
